description.index: I work across insurance, software and projects for the local community. I like following ideas from the first questions through the decisions needed to make them work.
description.family: I’m Sara’s husband and Chiara and Rachele’s dad. My family gives meaning to the other parts of my life too.
description.insurance: My insurance work spans Assistudio and Scegli Noi. I work on clients’ needs and how to organise services, people and tools to support them.
description.entrepreneurship: I work on direction, people and product. I try to turn a need into a sustainable project, following the decisions and the work needed to carry it forward.
description.software: Technical skills are part of how I approach business. They let me connect people’s needs to product decisions, assess feasibility and take part in building the solution.
description.finance: I’m interested in how numbers connect to decisions: time, risk, available resources and the effects of our choices. That curiosity also shapes the way I approach business.
description.church: I’m a catechist in my parish. Accompanying young people is an important part of my life: time to listen, ask questions and explore together.
description.projects: Business, product and organisation are parts of my work. Here are some of the settings I contribute to, what I work on and the tools I’ve built.
description.palio: The Palio of Vigevano is one way I take part in my city’s life: through its people, its history and the work that brings everyone together each year.

title.index: Francesco Dulio — CEO, product and development
title.insurance: Insurance, Assistudio and Scegli Noi — Francesco Dulio
title.entrepreneurship: Business, people and decisions — Francesco Dulio

index.heroOpening: I build businesses. I work with people and products. I also write code.
index.heroSupporting: I work across insurance, software and projects for the local community. I like following ideas from the first questions through the decisions needed to make them work.
whatIWorkOnList: Multi-stakeholder systems where alignment isn't given
High ambiguity and variability—where playbooks don't exist
Decisions with real consequences, not theoretical exercises
Systems that need structure, not noise
index.activityAssistudioText: Multi-agency insurance firm active since 1986, offering policies, financial advisory, and long-term rental.
index.activityIsicoText: Italian Scientific Institute for the Spine: non-surgical spine rehabilitation, research, and training.
index.activityScegliNoiText: I’m a partner and insurance agent at Scegli Noi. It began in 2021 as a network of agencies in Lombardy and Veneto and has become a company with 10 insurance agents.
index.activityStayActiveText: Wearable device with an app that alerts incorrect posture via vibration. Project closed.
howIWorkList: I take ownership of outcomes, not just tasks
I make decisions when information is incomplete
I build for durability, not demonstration
I say no to things that don't matter
index.signature:
Physics mindset.
Piano discipline.
Always asking why.
Building for passion, not noise.
index.familyText: Sara, Chiara and Rachele. My family, and the starting point for everything else.
index.palioText: My involvement in the Palio of Vigevano, through people, organisation and digital tools.
index.faithText: I’m a catechist in my parish. A commitment made of conversations, questions and listening.
index.elsewhereText: The Alps, classical piano and photography: walking, playing, taking time to look.

family.heroSupporting: I’m Sara’s husband and Chiara and Rachele’s dad. My family gives meaning to the other parts of my life too.
aboutUsList: Sara is a physiotherapist. She’s my wife, and we share our life and the decisions that concern us.
Chiara and Rachele are our daughters. Being their dad is an essential part of who I am.
Vigevano is home: our life, work and many of the people I care about meet here.
I try to be present in the everyday things, including while I’m pursuing ideas and projects.
foundationList: Time together, even when there’s nothing special planned.
The children’s questions, which often shift my point of view.
Faith, and trying to put what I believe into practice.
family.signature:
There’s something to learn every day.
About listening, changing plans,
and making room for others.
family.intro: My urge to build things finds its way here as well: I’ve created tools for homes, the children’s calendar and school. They grow out of needs close to me, things I know from the inside.

palioPage.heroSupporting: The Palio of Vigevano is one way I take part in my city’s life: through its people, its history and the work that brings everyone together each year.
theSystemList: The contrade, with their people and their stories.
The volunteers and contributors looking after the many aspects of the event.
The participants and visitors who make the Palio a celebration for the city.
myRoleList: Give the work direction, sharing priorities and responsibilities.
Follow relationships with institutions, sponsors and the people involved in the organisation.
Connect organisational needs to digital tools, contributing to their development too.
Handle unexpected issues, make decisions and collect what we can improve for the next edition.
palioPage.signature:
Behind a day of celebration
are many people.
I’m glad to be one of them.
palioPage.intro: I’m president of Associazione Sforzinda, which organises the Palio of Vigevano. Alongside the organisational work, I build digital tools. It means moving between meetings and practical issues on the ground, with people giving their time.

insurance.heroSupporting: My insurance work spans Assistudio and Scegli Noi. I work on clients’ needs and how to organise services, people and tools to support them.
myApproachList: Understand clients’ needs and make them clear to the people handling them.
Choose which processes to improve and which tools are actually needed.
Clarify responsibilities and handovers between the people involved.
Assess the work over time, considering service quality and available resources.
techIntegrationList: A client portal and dedicated tools for claims.
Quotes, enquiries and automation of repetitive steps.
Tools for pension calculations and completing the CAI accident statement.
Service integrations that need attention and corrections after going online.
insurance.signature:
Listen to the question.
Make the steps clear.
Follow what happens next.
lookingAheadList: At Assistudio, decisions meet the everyday work of clients and colleagues.
At Scegli Noi I’m a partner and insurance agent, working with a company of 10 insurance agents.
I’m interested in ways of collaborating that make roles and handovers clearer.
Software supports those decisions and needs the same attention after going online.
insurance.intro: I’m a partner in Assistudio Vigevano and a partner and insurance agent at Scegli Noi. I work both with people and their enquiries and on how we organise ourselves to support them. This is where business responsibilities meet my ability to work directly on processes and software.

entrepreneurship.heroSupporting: I work on direction, people and product. I try to turn a need into a sustainable project, following the decisions and the work needed to carry it forward.
stayActiveList: I led a startup exploring technology, health and posture.
The project combined a wearable device and an app to alert users to incorrect posture.
I followed the work from idea to product, alongside the people involved.
StayActive has closed. It remains part of what I’ve learned about products, limits and responsibility.
howIBuildList: Identify the need and decide whom we want to help.
Choose priorities with time, resources and financial sustainability in mind.
Connect people’s needs to product and organisational decisions.
Follow execution and revisit assumptions in light of the results.
entrepreneurship.signature:
A direction to choose.
People to work with.
Results to take responsibility for.
teamPhilosophyList: Share the reasons behind decisions and the goals we’re working towards.
Clarify responsibilities, room for autonomy and limits, including my own.
Listen to people who know a problem from a different angle.
Create the conditions to work together and recognise others’ contributions.
entrepreneurship.intro: What interests me is the connection between an idea and the reality of an organisation: what we choose to do, with whom, with which resources and with which responsibilities. Being able to develop software helps me assess how to build it too.
entrepreneurship.currentText: I’m a partner in Assistudio Vigevano and a partner and insurance agent at Scegli Noi. At Scegli Noi, the business network has grown into a company with 10 insurance agents: a journey connecting agency work, professional collaboration and organisational decisions.

software.heroOpening: From need to product. Down to the code.
software.heroSupporting: Technical skills are part of how I approach business. They let me connect people’s needs to product decisions, assess feasibility and take part in building the solution.
philosophyList: Clarify the need, the people we’re building for and the intended outcome.
Choose the scope of a first version and what to postpone.
Assess feasibility, costs and maintenance alongside the user experience.
Consider readability and accessibility in product decisions.
software.techStack: When it’s time to get into the details
techStackList: Swift for applications in the Apple ecosystem.
JavaScript and TypeScript for websites, web applications and integrations.
Bash, APIs and AI tools when they help address the problem.
software.signature:
Choose what to build.
Understand how to make it.
Follow it as people use it.
software.whatIBuild: Products and settings I contribute to
whatIBuildList: Into ISICOApp, supporting clinical and rehabilitation journeys.
Into Assistudio’s tools for clients, claims and agency work.
Into the websites and applications supporting the Palio’s organisation.
Into family projects, from homes to the children’s calendar and school.
software.intro: I write code and work on the decisions that come before and after it: what is worth building, for whom, with which priorities and how to maintain it. My interest in physics is there too, in wanting to understand mechanisms and their limits.
software.isicoText: I work on an app used by patients and professionals. That means thinking about clear steps, text size and the experience on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch. These are aspects to keep working on, listening to the needs of the people using the app.

finance.heroSupporting: I’m interested in how numbers connect to decisions: time, risk, available resources and the effects of our choices. That curiosity also shapes the way I approach business.
financialMarketsList: What resources does a decision require, now and over time?
What assumptions sit behind a number or a simulation?
How much room are we allowing for uncertainty?
How do we make the reasoning clear to the people deciding?
digitalAssetsList: Gather information that helps describe a situation.
Make the assumptions behind a simulation explicit.
Use software to make complex questions easier to explore.
Read results with the model’s limits in mind.
finance.signature:
I’m interested in numbers.
And even more in the questions
behind them.
finance.riskManagement: How it connects to the rest
riskManagementList: To insurance, through the relationship between choices, risk and protection.
To software, through turning a calculation into a usable tool.
To business, through decisions made with limited resources and information.
To everyday life, because different needs sit behind each scenario.
finance.intro: A project requires choosing where to put time and resources, which assumptions to make and how much room to leave for uncertainty. I want to make those lines of reasoning explicit and comparable, including through the tools I build.
finance.exampleText: Among the tools I’ve built for Assistudio is a pension calculator. It’s an example of how my interest in numbers meets building a practical application.

church.heroSupporting: I’m a catechist in my parish. Accompanying young people is an important part of my life: time to listen, ask questions and explore together.
myRoleList: Serving as a catechist with the young people in my parish.
Meeting and discussing the questions they bring.
Taking part in the life of the community.
Mass and the time I make for faith in my week.
youthEducationList: What does the Gospel have to do with our lives?
How do we face doubts, choices and relationships?
How do we make room for someone who finds it harder to speak?
What can I learn from the way they see things?
visionForChangeList: Listening, including when I don’t immediately share a point of view.
Words that are understandable and connected to the life we’re living.
A willingness to have my own ideas questioned.
My practical skills, when they can help the community.
church.intro: Faith shapes how I relate to others and the questions I ask myself. I don’t have a ready answer for everything. I want to be present, including when a conversation is difficult or remains open.

projects.heroOpening: From decisions to projects taking shape.
projects.heroSupporting: Business, product and organisation are parts of my work. Here are some of the settings I contribute to, what I work on and the tools I’ve built.
projects.title: Projects
projects.introLine1: It’s a selection of real systems I have built, led, or contributed to,
projects.introLine2: in contexts where ambiguity, responsibility, and real-world consequences were present.
currentFocusList: Decisions carry operational, reputational, or economic weight
Long-term sustainability matters more than short-term visibility
projects.palioIntro: As president of Associazione Sforzinda I work on the organisation of the Palio of Vigevano. Alongside coordination responsibilities, I’ve built websites and applications for the board, contrade, costumes, games and participants.
projects.palioContext: The context includes real logistical, organizational, and reputational risk.
palioRoleList: Take responsibility where formal structure is missing
Enable coordination across very different actors
Ensure continuity and reliability year after year
projects.palioClosing: This is an example of leadership without formal authority, applied at real scale.
projects.stayActiveIntro: A startup exploring technology, health and posture, with a wearable device and an app. The project has closed; it taught me a lot about the step from idea to product.
projects.stayActiveClosed: The project is now closed, but it remains a formative experience.
stayActiveRoleList: To execution, partnerships, and external positioning
projects.stayActiveClosing: StayActive shaped how I approach system design, decision-making under pressure, and the cost of real-world constraints.
projects.healthcareIntro: I contribute to developing ISICOApp, supporting clinical and rehabilitation journeys. My work connects the needs of patients and professionals with interface decisions and software development.
healthcareFocusList: Translating complex clinical needs into usable systems
Reliability in contexts where trust and accuracy are critical
projects.healthcareClosing: This work reinforced a system-oriented approach in environments where errors have real consequences.
projects.insuranceIntro: I’m a partner in Assistudio. Alongside insurance work, I work on decisions about processes and tools for clients and colleagues. I’ve built applications for the client portal, claims, quotes, pensions and CAI accident statements.
insuranceWorkList: Redesigning processes where legacy structures no longer scale
Introducing automation and digital tools responsibly
Supporting decision-making in contexts with economic exposure
projects.insuranceClosing: The emphasis is always on making systems work, not just making them modern.
projects.communityIntro: Serving as a catechist and taking part in parish life are parts of my experience. On the dedicated page I describe what I try to bring to my time with the young people.
communitySystemsList: Under strong ethical and relational constraints
projects.communityClosing: They provide a different but valuable perspective on coordination, trust, and long-term engagement.
projects.connectIntro: Across very different domains, the pattern is consistent:
connectList: Structure must often be built while moving
Systems must work with real people, not ideal ones
projects.connectClosing: That’s where I tend to operate best.
projects.githubIntro: GitHub holds some of my code and other projects too. This list is loaded from my public repositories.
projects.githubError: Unable to load repositories right now.
projects.familyToolsIntro: Some tools I’ve built for my family: homes, the children’s calendar and school. Needs close to home also become opportunities to build something useful.

studio.description: I work across insurance, software and projects for the local community. I like following ideas from the first questions through the decisions needed to make them work.
studio.sceneCaption: Business, product and the ability to build it.
studio.footnote: From the first decisions to everyday work.
studio.workIntro: My contribution depends on the context: organisation and business decisions, product development, or coordinating an event. I try to keep direction connected to what it takes to deliver.
studio.healthText: At ISICOApp I contribute to product development, translating the needs of patients and professionals into practical software and interface decisions.
studio.insuranceText: At Assistudio I connect insurance work, organisation and digital tools. Decisions about processes and software start with the needs of clients and colleagues.
studio.palioText: As president of Sforzinda I work with the people, relationships and organisation behind the Palio. I also bring the ability to build the digital tools supporting that work.
studio.methodTitle:
Understand the need.
Choose what to do.
Follow it through.
studio.methodDescription: I bring needs, people and resources together. That means choosing priorities, working with time and financial constraints, and creating the conditions for collaboration. Technical skills let me get into the product and assess its details too.
studio.methodOne: Clarify the need, the goals and the resources available.
studio.methodTwo: Share priorities and responsibilities with the people involved.
studio.methodThree: Follow the results and revisit decisions when needed.
studio.personalIntro: Family, faith, mountains and piano. These parts of my life also shape the way I work.
studio.contactText: To discuss a business, a product or a project to develop. Write to me.
studio.reducedMotion: Animations disabled by your system preferences
studio.networkText: I’m a partner and insurance agent at Scegli Noi, a company of 10 agents that grew out of a business network. We work by sharing expertise and different perspectives.

scegliNoi.title: Scegli Noi / partner and insurance agent
scegliNoi.description: I’m a partner and insurance agent at Scegli Noi. It began in 2021 as a network of agencies in Lombardy and Veneto and has become a company with 10 insurance agents.
scegliNoi.approach: I’m interested in the move from collaboration between separate businesses to a shared organisation: exchanging experience, making responsibilities clear and providing continuity for clients.
scegliNoi.services: Insurance work is at its core, alongside collaboration with other professionals, including financial advisory and long-term rental services.
